terraserena.quote: Their 2026–27 wedding PDF: venue MXN 210,000 including IVA for 150–600 guests (8 hours; bride's room, staff, cleaning, security, 1,000 m² paved esplanade for up to 420, garden up to 600, 24 bottles of house wine). The party must end by midnight; extra hours are 10% of the total. Banquet is exclusive to Villa Ferré, plated 3 courses: MXN 1,350 / 1,490 / 1,600 a guest + IVA. The tent is also an exclusive supplier: MXN 99,000 (300 guests), 132,000 (420) or 165,000 (550) + IVA. Red wine service is theirs only (cases of 12 at MXN 5,400). MXN 80,000 holds the date, paid off 2 months before; MXN 50,000 refundable damage deposit; 5% off for paying in full; portable toilets needed for vendors during setup. No rooms (partner hotels in Saltillo). About 30 minutes from Saltillo.
